swift-red.why_this_one: Recorded from a run made deliberately red on the throwaway branch measure-a-red-parallel-swift-log, because no ordinary red swift-unit run existed in parallel mode: the only historical one predates #992 and is in the SERIAL format, `Test Case '-[Module.Class method]' failed`, which is not what the runner prints any more. One red log is evidence for both this family's patterns, since it carries a work count AND a failure, which a green log cannot (L159).

note: What each log HOLDS is read off it by hand and written here, never produced by the code under test: a fixture whose expectations came from the pattern can only prove the pattern agrees with itself (L58, L70). `read_off` quotes the line each number came from so the next reader can check it without trusting this file.
